decisions.reason: As a newly launched, close-to-core product line in a growing market, the LED track spotlight is still an attractive option to keep open because uncertainty has not yet resolved and maintaining it likely supports the firm's broad, design-led system offering at limited additional cost.

The LED ceiling luminaire fits the firm's established range and channel relationships, so with no visible evidence of underperformance after only one year the option value of learning and completing the portfolio outweighs the case for withdrawal.
